entries.reason: No patched version exists: both advisories cover every published image-size release (<=2.0.2), so no override pin can clear them. The vulnerable copy is pulled by texture-compressor (deck.gl -> @loaders.gl/textures) and is a Node-side CLI image parser used only at texture-conversion time by loaders.gl tooling; it is not reachable from the browser bundle at runtime. Re-check when @loaders.gl/textures ships a release dropping texture-compressor, or when image-size publishes >2.0.2, and remove this entry.
